purpose: Machine-readable restart authority for FuturePerfectLive 2026-27. Do not request or regenerate a human-readable master ZIP unless the owner explicitly asks.
owner_invariants: Never rollback/revert as recovery. Fix forward from current state and preserve later valid changes and unrelated features.
Do not infer or broaden business rules beyond owner approval.
Inspect current workbook/repo before mutation when later state may exist.
After owner-approved workbook changes, update this same GitHub authority; Git history is the version history.

binary_workbook.caveat: The exact binary after all 28-Sep VBA edits was not uploaded. This authority plus the verbatim source chunks below records the confirmed state. If a future task depends on exact live binary state, inspect the then-current workbook before mutation.

live_sheet.name: Live
live_sheet.completed_tbc_key: Lesson Date + Subject + Tutor + Time + EXACT Live lesson code

Completed: Selected row(s) identify exact class/lesson combinations.
All matching student rows are marked Completed.
Success is silent; warning/failure MsgBoxes remain.
TBC: Affect only the exact selected lesson; never reopen Completed rows.
Current row Remarks becomes Completed till slide X and Status becomes Slide X.
Copy the same lesson to each matching student's next future row; Remarks becomes Start from slide X and Status becomes Ready.
On that future row M / PLSS Informed = Not Applicable because PreLesson Sheets were already issued.
On that future row N / HW Informed remains blank because homework is still outstanding.
Continuing_Lesson: Create one new row per unique student in the selected physical class, processing bottom-to-top.
New row copies A-D,G,K,L; E is blank before planning; F=0 with cell comment Continuing lesson; H/Received=0; I,J,M,N blank.
Track the new row belonging to the originally selected student as later insertions shift row numbers.
After all new rows are created, select column E of that tracked row and call LessonPlan exactly once so LessonPlan fills the other blank continuation rows for the class.
Y6MS_parser: It supports Year 6 Maths SATS Y6MS1..Y6MS19 as separate family Y6MS.
Do not rename Drive Y6MS folders to Y6Mxx to accommodate an outdated parser.

portal_interface.absence_guardrail: Owner rejected classifying the prior absence/email discussion as a defect or encoding a broad absent-row suppression rule. Reconfirm exact desired behaviour before changing absence/email logic.

verbatim_source_chunks.assembly_rule: Concatenate each module's chunks in numeric order with no inserted text. The resulting source must match the recorded SHA-256 below.

restart_protocol: Then read all verbatim source chunks for any module being changed and concatenate in numeric order if exact source is needed.
Treat owner_invariants and confirmed_rules as binding until explicitly superseded.
For workbook modules not stored verbatim here, use source_hashes to detect drift and inspect the current workbook before editing.
For Portal V2 public/live code, inspect current main HEAD and production; do not assume workbook-side snapshots represent later portal changes.
After an approved change, update CURRENT.json and any affected verbatim source chunks rather than creating another human-readable master ZIP.
